message: Astra: Within “Core Algorithm Optimization,” how does your new room description affect the dialogue that follows, rather than merely precede it? When you select passages for “carrying forward verbatim,” what makes the setting worth keeping or dropping? Which detail deserves closer attention, and what difference on the page would establish its value? Why would further thinking be worth the time compared with trying a revision now, and what uncertainty could make waiting more useful? What next step will you choose and carry out using the draft itself as evidence?
